snippet.title: Back to the Dawn Release Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Award-Winning Lockup Escape Game!
Back to the Dawn
Coming to PlayStation 5 on October 22, 2026!

The globally acclaimed escape RPG returns—now with polished subtitles and brand-new Japanese and Chinese voice acting to bring the drama to life like never before.

Step into a maximum-security animal prison where crime, conspiracy, and betrayal run deep. As an inmate, you’ll fight to survive, make friends (or enemies), and plot your way to freedom.

Break free. Uncover the truth. Survive the darkness.


Title: Back to the Dawn
Genre: Prison Break RPG
Platforms: PlayStation®5 / Nintendo Switch™ 2 / Nintendo Switch™ 
Release Date: 
　PlayStation®5: October 22, 2026
　Nintendo Switch™ 2 / Nintendo Switch™: March 5, 2026
Audio: Japanese/Chinese
Subtitles: English/Traditional Chinese/Simplified Chinese/Korean/Japanese/Spanish (Latin America)/ Portuguese (Brazil)
Official Site: https://www.cloudedleopardent.com/game/bttd/en/


©2026 Metal Head Games.
©2026 Spiral Up Games.
